intentAndPurpose.intent: Icon-only toggle button for compact binary selection with configurable shape layout.

props.name: attention
props.description: Attention level — determines the visual prominence of the SELECTED state. high → bold fill; medium → subtle fill; low → ghost with accent border. The UNSELECTED state is always muted ghost regardless of attention. Default: 'high'.

props.name: condensed
props.description: Condensed mode: reduces container size while keeping same icon size

props.name: contained
props.description: When true (default), renders a contained icon button with background, border, and sized container. When false, renders just the icon without container — no background, border, or fixed size. condensed and fullWidth do not apply when contained=false.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch to fill container width. Only applies when contained=true.

props.name: loading
props.description: Loading state — shows circular progress indicator

props.name: selected
props.description: Selected state (controlled). Maps to Toggle pressed.

props.name: size
props.description: Button size — dimension step number or t-shirt alias. Default: 10 (M).

interactionBehavior.summary: SelectableIconButton is a Base UI Toggle, so every click flips `aria-pressed`, and it starts UNSELECTED (`defaultSelected` is unset). Attention colours the SELECTED look only; unselected is always a muted ghost. It scales UP on press (`--Motion-Tap-Scale-Up`, 7%) — the opposite direction to SelectableButton's squash — with NO pressed fill token. `contained={false}` strips the container so hover fills never apply and even the uncontained hover rule only re-asserts `background-color: transparent`. `aria-label` is required. `loading` implies disabled: the icon goes to `opacity: 0` and a centred spinner takes over without the button changing size.
hover: Every hover rule is wrapped in `@media (hover: hover)` and excluded for `[data-disabled]`.
UNSELECTED contained tints the transparent rest fill to `--{Role}-Hover`.

SELECTED contained high steps to `--{Role}-Bold-Hover` (or keeps `--{Role}-Material-Fill`); selected medium steps to `--{Role}-Subtle-Hover`; selected low ADDS a `--{Role}-Hover` fill over the rest transparent-plus-accent-hairline.
`contained={false}` hover rules exist but only pin `background-color: transparent` — they do not shift the icon colour — so an uncontained selectable is visually inert on hover.
Icon colour never changes on hover for the contained button either; only the background does.
press: The whole button scales UP: `scale(calc(1 + var(--_tap-direction) * var(--_tap-scale) / 100))` with `--Motion-Tap-Scale-Up` at 7% and `--_tap-direction: 1`. SelectableButton scales DOWN; this matches IconButton, Checkbox, and Radio instead.
`fullWidth` stretches the box but does NOT remap the tap-scale — unlike IconButton, there is no `--Motion-Tap-Scale-FullWidth` override, so a wide selectable icon button still grows 7%.
There is no `:active` fill, border, or icon-colour rule — the scale-up is the entire pressed look.
The scale is NOT `(hover: hover)`-guarded and is NOT excluded for `contained={false}`, so an uncontained icon still grows on tap even though its colours do not change.
focus: Keyboard focus draws the two-layer halo: an inner `--Stroke-XL` gap ring in `--Surface-Halo-Gap` plus an outer ring at `calc(--Stroke-XL + --Focus-Outline-Width)` in `--Focus-Outline` (brand-overridable via `--SelectableIconButton-focusOutlineWidth` / `--SelectableIconButton-focusOutlineColor`).
`:focus` alone only clears the native outline; the visible ring is `:focus-visible`.
With `contained={false}` the button sets `border-radius: 0` and hugs the glyph, so the halo is a tight square around the icon rather than a pill ring.
keyboard: Base UI Toggle renders a native `<button aria-pressed>`, so `Enter` and `Space` both toggle — both paths are covered by tests.
`aria-label` is required by the type signature; a missing label fires a dev-mode `console.warn`.
Controlled via `selected` / `onSelectedChange`; uncontrolled via `defaultSelected` (unset → unselected). Pass `value` when nesting inside a ToggleGroup.
Disabled and loading are natively `disabled`, so they are out of the tab order.
selected: Selected maps to Base UI Toggle's `pressed`, exposed as `aria-pressed` and matched in CSS with `[data-pressed]`.
It defaults to unselected in uncontrolled mode.

`attention` colours the SELECTED contained look only: high → `--{Role}-Bold` fill with `--{Role}-Bold-High` icon and a transparent border; medium → `--{Role}-Subtle` fill with `--{Role}-TintedA11y` icon; low → transparent fill with a `--{Role}-Bold` hairline and accent icon. Unselected is always transparent + `--{Role}-Medium-Text` icon + `--{Role}-Stroke-Low` hairline, ignoring attention.

`contained={false}` never paints a pill. Counter-intuitive: uncontained selected high colours the icon with `--{Role}-Bold` (the fill token), not `--{Role}-Bold-High`; selected medium/low use `--{Role}-High`. Uncontained unselected high uses `--{Role}-High`.
loading: `loading` implies disabled — `isDisabled = disabled || loading` — so the native `disabled` attribute is set and `onSelectedChange` stops firing.
`aria-busy="true"` and `data-loading` are set; the `.loading` class is applied.
The icon goes to `opacity: 0` rather than leaving the tree, which keeps the box size stable. The spinner is absolutely positioned across the button so it sits centred over the hidden glyph.
disabled: `data-disabled` dims to `--Disabled-Opacity` (brand-overridable via `--SelectableIconButton-disabledOpacity`) and sets `cursor: not-allowed` plus `pointer-events: none`.

Because the element is natively `disabled` AND has `pointer-events: none`, the `not-allowed` cursor is not observable — the pointer shows the parent's cursor. Known, accepted system-wide gap (see docs/design/disabled-states.md).
Hover fills and the tap-scale are qualified with `:not([data-disabled])`. Disabling does not clear the selected styling — it only dims it.
touch: Hover fills never apply on touch-only devices; the 7% scale-up is the entire visual response to a tap, because there is no pressed fill.
Growing on press is deliberate for a small glyph control — the button expands out from under the fingertip that is covering the icon.
